infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BioSync AI requires camera access to scan packaged food barcodes, dining plates, and biometric nutrition labels.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BioSync AI requires microphone access to enable vernacular voice meal logging and spoken dietary feedback in Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Marathi, and English.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BioSync AI uses your location to identify certified cloud kitchens, regional culinary availability, and dispatch home phlebotomy technicians.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: BioSync AI connects via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to stream continuous pulse wave velocity, heart rate variability, and biometric telemetry from wearable sensors.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: BioSync AI connects to compatible wireless wearable devices and glucose monitoring sensors.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BioSync AI accesses your photo library to allow selecting meal images for AI-driven nutritional decomposition and glycemic simulation.
